## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与修改后行为

Describe the concrete change and its scope. / 说明具体修改及范围。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] Local build and offline tests pass / 构建与离线测试通过
- [ ] Source hygiene check passes / 源码检查通过
- [ ] Real-app evidence is stated accurately, including untested cases / 如实列出实测与未测试情况
- [ ] Translation changes state the language pairs tested / 翻译改动已说明测试过的语言组合
- [ ] User-visible changes update both documentation languages / 用户可见变化已同步双语文档
- [ ] No keys, personal settings or real conversations included / 不含密钥、个人配置或真实聊天

## Provenance / 来源

Identify external code/assets and substantial AI assistance, if any. Confirm you can submit your contribution under the project license. / 说明外部代码、素材及重要 AI 辅助部分，并确认有权按项目许可提交。
